title: BlocEvent
tagline: A decentralized event app, where organizers can create, sell event tickets and airdrop poap to attendees
description:
BlockEvent is an all-in-one event management product with limitless boundaries we made use of the following technology stacks in the production 
Web3storage(IPFS), Tableland, Polygon, Nftport, Spheron.

Overview
Event organizers can come to our platform and create an event with the option to sell as an NFT, set price and also tract the analysis of the events like the number of tickets bought amongst other vital features. Also, users or event goers can buy this ticket and also resell it in case there is a change in plan or unforeseen circumstance.
how_its_made:
We stored nfts of an event to web3storage and deployed the contract on polygonMumbai, 
we used tableland for storing and querying details that are specific to the event. 
NFTPort: we used nftPort to mint a special kind of nft for every event organizer, 
Spheron: spheron was used for frontend development, 
POAP: we used poap to mint a proof of attendance to goers of an event
